title: Add QEMU rootfs replay gate status panel
verified: gate.status.show renders TUI Gate Status as a read-only projection over QEMU, rootfs and replay gate artifacts.
The panel projects AGENTOS_TUI_CONSOLE_READY, observed runtime markers, QEMU path, log path and runtime manifest marker from boot smoke evidence.
Rootfs runtime manifest status shows recorded sha256, runtime manifest sha256, runtime artifact counts and hash_tied_to_release_provenance=true when release provenance binds the hash.
Missing gate artifacts render status=missing, missing_gate_artifact=true and gate_blocker entries; missing evidence cannot be treated as pass.
TUI exposes qemu_execution_in_tui=false, rootfs_validation_in_tui=false, replay_execution_in_tui=false and artifact_generation_in_tui=false.
tui-replay and production-runbook-smoke include gate.status.show and assert the gate status panel remains read-only.
QEMU boot smoke observed AGENTOS_TUI_CONSOLE_READY with E:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe.
risk_notes: Gate status panel reads local artifacts only and never executes QEMU, rootfs validation or replay scripts.
Gate execution remains in scripts and CI paths.
TUI remains projection-controller only; AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine authority boundaries are unchanged.
